title: Bluesky Meetup Event Configuration
description: Public details and branding for one event. Keep credentials, organizer authorization and retention settings in the private environment file. Runtime validation checks actual timezones, normalized origins and date ordering; preflight checks launch readiness.

$schema.description: Editor schema reference. Use ./event.schema.json when the schema is beside this config. This is metadata, not a runtime network request.

name.description: Full event name, used in the page heading, social card, calendar and OAuth sign-in screen.

community.description: Short community line displayed above the event heading.

tagline.description: Short invitation below the heading and on the social card.

description.description: Plain-text event description for social metadata and calendar details. Do not use HTML.
examples: Meet your Hill Valley Bluesky neighbors.

origin.description: Exact public HTTPS origin, without a trailing slash, path, credentials, query or fragment. Local development may use http://127.0.0.1:PORT. APP_ORIGIN can override it at runtime; align both for launch.

startAt.description: Event start instant with seconds and an explicit offset or Z. Use the correct offset for the intended local date, including daylight-saving time.

endAt.description: Event end instant, strictly after startAt. Cross-field ordering is checked by the app.

timeZone.description: IANA timezone used to display event dates and times. The app checks that the timezone exists; this does not change the instants in startAt/endAt.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for date/time formatting and the HTML language attribute. The app checks locale validity.

calendarUid.description: Stable, unique calendar event identifier. Keep it when correcting the same event; create a new one for a different event. It is not a URL.

venue.description: Venue details used on the page, social card and calendars.

address.description: Complete visitor-facing street address, including city when needed.

url.description: Public HTTPS venue website, without credentials.

branding.description: Public branding assets. Paths must name root-level PNG/SVG files in public/. The build and preflight check the actual files.

name.description: Community name for the web manifest and the first social-card title line when it prefixes the event name.

color.description: Primary UI/theme color in six-digit hexadecimal notation. Does not recolor the logo.

mark.description: Main community mark, also embedded in the generated social card.

markAlt.description: Accessible description of the main mark.

appleTouchIcon.description: 180 by 180 pixel PNG Apple touch icon.

socialImage.description: Social-card PNG. /social-preview.png is generated from the config at build time; a different path uses your supplied image unchanged.

socialImageAlt.description: Accessible image description. The app appends the event name and details.
examples: Event information card with the Bluesky butterfly logo on a white background

socialImageWidth.description: Actual social-card width in pixels, also used by the default card generator.

socialImageHeight.description: Actual social-card height in pixels, also used by the default card generator.
